format_notes: Each entry maps to the SanctionsEntry interface: { name: string; registration_number?: string; reason: string }. When populating from a real feed, map Uganda FIA Designated Persons list (https://www.fia.go.ug) and UN Consolidated Sanctions List (https://scsanctions.un.org) fields as follows — UN: 'FIRST_NAME'+'SECOND_NAME'+'THIRD_NAME' → name; 'ENTITY_ID' or 'INDIVIDUAL_ID' → registration_number (omit if not applicable); 'COMMENTS1' or listing resolution → reason. FIA Uganda: 'entity_name' → name; 'registration_number' → registration_number (if corporate); 'listing_basis' → reason. Refresh this file at least monthly and on every regulatory update. Never commit real PII of listed individuals; use only the legally published designation name.
